known_caveats: Historical species-specific positive fish counts at sampled locations. Partial effort, sampling-frame geography and source-specific holds remain explicit; no absence follows from missing records or sampling flags.
source_warnings: Historical sampled presence only; retrieval does not establish current persistence, reproduction, establishment, countywide abundance or completeness.
Missing rows, excluded records, repeat visits, effort flags and taxonomic holds never establish absence or non-detection.
Original numeric county codes restore one leading zero only when active county name and primary postal-state identity agree independently. Retired or contradictory geography is not reassigned.
A two-state publisher STATE qualifier is usable only when it exactly equals BORD_RIV and includes the independently matching primary postal state.
Generalized county polygons and source frame coordinates diagnose conflicts. Small boundary offsets alone neither reject exact publisher identity nor assign a different county.

The pinned site CSV contains exactly two original 0xF1 bytes in one Rio Penasco record. Reversible ISO-8859-1 interpretation is local to this file; source bytes, row hashes and line terminators are unchanged.
Independent agent review and machine reconstruction are not individual human specimen verification. Original INDEX_VISIT, NON_NATIVE, anomaly and sampling flags remain retained.
